messages:
Amy: Evening handoff — quick async standup. What I did / blockers / today.

Jordan: What I did: rolled kv-evict fix to canary (eu-west). Observed tail latency drop ~0.6s. No errors.
Lee: Blocker: still seeing sporadic 504s on batcher when burst > 200 req/s. Investigating.
Ravi: Today: follow up on alert tuning, will open PR to reduce noisy paging for 'kv-cache-evict' alert.
Amy: @Jordan can you post the canary logs? want the `evict_job` stacktrace if any.
Jordan: posted logs: ```
2026-03-17T23:02:14Z evict_job: started batch 42
2026-03-17T23:02:14Z evict_job: removed 128 keys
2026-03-17T23:02:15Z batcher: timeout waiting for response (code 504)
``` 
Amy: thx. Lee — could the 504s be autoscaler spin up lag? 
Lee: maybe. I saw spike in queue depth before 504s. I'll add a short warmup (prefill) to batcher on scale events.
Ravi: I'll draft the alert PR: lower sensitivity, add a 5m suppression window for warmups, and include a note to oncall runbook.
Oncall Bot: Reminder: oncall rotation tonight is Jordan -> Lee -> Amy. Escalation: Pager -> Phone -> Exec.
Jordan: FYI I left a review on `infra/batcher/warmup` PR #472 — one minor nits.
Amy: Pinged @Lee for CR on #472, and left a followup task to land canary to 50% if no regressions by 12h.
Lee: CR'd, LGTM. I'll merge and kick canary to 50% in ~30m.
Ravi: Also adding a note: if we see >3 504s in 10m post-merge, automatic rollback to previous batcher image.
Jordan: Deploy-bot: `batcher warmup` image deployed to canary (hash abc123) — health checks green.
deploy-bot: deployment_id=deploy_7743210000, status=success
Amy: Blockers: none from my side. Today: monitor post-merge metrics and adjust alert thresholds if noise persists.
Lee: I'll add a quick synthetic that simulates burst load to verify warmup helps.
Jordan: CQ: should we adjust SLO slack for batcher from 99.95 -> 99.9 during rollout window? Prefer to avoid immediate pager noise.
Amy: Let's keep SLO target but add temporary runbook note to relax paging (silence) for rollout tag `warmup-1` for 1h, not change SLO.
Ravi: I'll open a short change in `slo/alerting` doc and ping infra-ops.
Amy: Thanks all — tagging summary for handoff: 1) PR #472 merged, 2) canary to 50% in 30m, 3) alert suppression PR upcoming, 4) oncall rotation Jordan->Lee->Amy. Ping in thread if you see spikes :eyes:
Jordan: noted, will watch dashboards and post if anything looks off. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Lee: thanks — will run synthetic and share results here.
Oncall Bot: Don't forget to run `./scripts/run-smoke.sh` after canary bump.
Amy: Command for smoke: `./scripts/run-smoke.sh --target batcher-canary`
Jordan: running it now.
Jordan: smoke green. no 504s in 5m window. :thumbsup:
Lee: synthetic shows 40% reduction in warmup latency tail. sending graphs.
Amy: great. I'll un-silence pager after 1h or earlier if stable. good handoff.
Ravi: Filed alert PR: https://git.internal/r/alerts/pull/131 (adds suppression + doc). 
Amy: sweet. End of handoff.
